title: Bringing in Hevy or Strong workouts says nothing is uploaded, but the workouts then go to the gym's leaderboard and the saved copy
what: The import screen says everything is processed on your phone and nothing is uploaded. The file itself is read on the phone, but once the workouts are in, they count like any other: their daily totals are sent to the gym's leaderboard for a gym member, and they go into the member's saved copy when backup is on. A privacy-minded member reads the line as 'these workouts never leave my phone'.
expected: The line promises only what is true: the file is read on the phone and never sent anywhere; the workouts you bring in are then treated like workouts you log here (backup, gym leaderboard).
who: members who bring in history from Hevy or Strong
fix_line: Say the file stays on the phone, and that imported workouts then count like any other workout

title: The same thing gets two names on one path: 'picture' and 'progress photo' on Body, 'the demo' and 'the sample member' on import
what: The Body page says 'Add a progress photo', but the Add measures page it opens says 'Add picture' and 'Take a picture' for the same photo. On the import screen, one card is headed 'The demo goes first', explains that 'the sample member's' workouts and name are removed, and then asks 'Your name, please. The demo's name goes with the demo.' A first-time member has to work out that these are the same thing.
expected: One name for one thing on every screen: 'progress photo' on Body and Add measures; 'sample workouts' (or one chosen word) throughout the import card.
who: members adding body photos, and new members importing over the sample data
fix_line: Pick one word for each and use it on every screen
